ownership: Official public active business-registration records published through the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania Open Data Portal
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS Socrata API. Pennsylvania's portal policy says datasets are offered free and without restriction.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata and selected-field API queries
redistribution of approved normalized public fields with source attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing dataset inclusion as independent proof of current operations, good standing, solvency, public access, licensure, or an open storefront
representing a reported business address or portal geocode as a verified physical operating site
representing this state registry as every business operating in Pennsylvania or the United States
exporting governor, principal-officer, registered-agent, or other person-linked names and records
representing the source alphabetical county code as a county FIPS code
silently discarding source duplicate filing-number rows or malformed ZIP extensions
merging organizations across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: Pennsylvania Department of State, Registered Businesses in PA Current by County, via data.pa.gov.
retention: Indefinite for immutable selected-field source and approved normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Approved normalized fields may be redistributed with Pennsylvania Department of State attribution, source refresh timestamp, source checksum, provenance, statutory-overcount warning, field exclusions, and status/address limitations retained; the selected-field raw snapshot remains internal.
personal_data_handling: Organization names and reported business addresses can identify individuals or residences. The connector uses the distinct-business view and deliberately excludes governor/principal-officer roles and officer names from the underlying repeated-row dataset, retains the selected source snapshot internally, and prohibits treating the remaining address as a public storefront or verified operating site.
